CAMERA_APPARATUS_MODEL.why_withdrawn: the depth camera on the physical M3 Pro is carried by the 6-DOF manipulator. A chassis-to-camera transform is therefore not a constant of the apparatus; it is a function of the arm pose
decomposition: base_link -> arm_base: from the authoritative description
arm kinematic chain: authoritative description plus joint states
arm mount link -> camera housing: physical measurement
housing -> RGB optical frame: calibration where available
CAMERA_APPARATUS_MODEL.future_episode_precondition: ARM_NAVIGATION_POSE_ADMISSION: every joint within its predeclared tolerance of the frozen navigation pose, checked BEFORE the production PRE capture. An arm off-pose refuses the episode rather than recording one under an unknown camera geometry
CAMERA_APPARATUS_MODEL.consequence: neither local candidate can supply the arm chain, which raises what the vendor archive has to provide
CAMERA_APPARATUS_MODEL.separate_later_experiment: deliberately moving the camera during navigation is a new intervention, not a variation folded into this baseline

reconciliation.semantic_role: drives odometry scale and commanded velocity
reconciliation.notes: the two local candidates disagree. The navfm value is read from its own twin manifest, which records the change and marks it PROVISIONAL_SIMULATION_VALUE, physically_measured false. Neither is a vendor value

reconciliation.semantic_role: what the camera is rigidly attached to
reconciliation.notes: WITHDRAWN ASSUMPTION. Both local candidates attach the camera rigidly to the chassis -- upstream by a fixed camera_joint from base_link, navfm by a static mast. The physical M3 Pro carries the depth camera on the 6-DOF manipulator, so neither local topology matches the robot and neither models the arm

reconciliation.semantic_role: the only genuinely fixed camera calibration
reconciliation.notes: measured from the arm link or bracket that physically carries the camera, never from the chassis. This is the transform that does not change when the manipulator moves

reconciliation.semantic_role: the frame of the RGB stream the model actually consumes
reconciliation.notes: upstream already separates housing from optical frame. A correctly attached camera is not a calibrated optical frame, and GNM/ViNT/NoMaD consume the optical frame

reconciliation.semantic_role: the frozen six-joint pose that makes the camera pose reproducible
reconciliation.notes: preregistered, not chosen per episode. With the arm locked the manipulator is a controlled camera mast rather than a second uncontrolled experimental factor

reconciliation.semantic_role: admission band on each joint before a production capture
reconciliation.notes: declared before any episode, not fitted to an observed pose

reconciliation.semantic_role: named physical datum if the optical centre cannot be established
